title: WorkPulse candidate.hired v1
description: An offered candidate was hired and the Employee record was created through the Employees seam in the same transaction (ADR 0020). Identifiers and the acting user only — no candidate or employee PII (`.ai/security.md`).

job_id.description: The job the candidate was hired for (UUIDv7 string).

employee_id.description: The Employee record created by the hire seam (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key — `employee_id` wins over `candidate_id` (ADR 0012).

hired_by.description: Actor user id that ran the hire (ADR 0010).
